intro.text: One of the Alethi highprinces, with a warcamp on the Shattered Plains between those of Sadeas and Dalinar.
An Alethi highprince who has broken with Sadeas and joined Dalinar Kholin's expedition across the Shattered Plains.
An Alethi highprince and Dalinar's Highprince of Information, responsible for policing the tower city of Urithiru.

items.text: Aladar became a highprince after Torol Sadeas killed Highprince Yenev in a duel; thanks to his alliance with Gavilar, Aladar was given Yenev's princedom. He and Sadeas went on to quarrel over territory.

Like the other highprinces, Aladar fought in the War of Reckoning from a warcamp on the Shattered Plains, between those of Sadeas and Dalinar. When Dalinar sought allies for a stronger push against the Parshendi, Aladar turned him down.

Aladar copied Sadeas in using bridgemen rather than armoured troops. Under Dalinar's new plateau-run rules he reluctantly took some of Dalinar's advice, but again refused an alliance and sided with Sadeas instead.

At the highprinces' meeting after the Assassin in White's attack on Dalinar, Aladar sided with Sadeas and Ruthar and complained about Elhokar taking the gemhearts. Dalinar vowed to win Shards from the other highprinces, and Aladar felt it when Adolin beat four opponents in one duel, among them a Shardbearer from Aladar's army.
When Sadeas released annotated copies of Dalinar's visions, Aladar, once among Dalinar's loudest opponents, seemed hesitant, almost saying something to Dalinar before thinking better of it.

When Dalinar marched on the Parshendi, Aladar surprised him by joining the expedition. He admitted he didn't share Dalinar's ideals but wanted them to be possible, and that he now saw Sadeas for the schemer he was.
On the march, Aladar worked out tactics with Roion, Renarin and General Khal, and they chose to push to the centre of the Shattered Plains.

Faced with the red-eyed Parshendi army, Aladar was rallied by Dalinar's call to be a champion. He killed the singing Parshendi on his plateau, but the Everstorm still came. He led his army onto the Oathgate plateau and was carried with the other survivors to Urithiru.

At Urithiru, Aladar became Highprince of Information, responsible for policing the tower. He had some success keeping order in the chaotic Breakaway market by setting up a policing station on its central dais.

Aladar attended Dalinar and Navani's wedding. When a corpse was found killed in the same way as Sadeas, Adolin worked with Aladar's policing teams on the investigation. Aladar's soldiers stayed tense with Sadeas's, but he quietly helped Navani get Teft released from a firemoss charge.
Aladar joined Dalinar's spanreed talks with other monarchs, advising him to use his knowledge of the Radiants as a bargaining tool. At another meeting, Ruthar rudely cut him down.
Aladar combined his forces with Dalinar's and Roion's to retake Kholinar, but as their armies waited at the Oathgate, word came that the city had fallen.
At the first meeting of monarchs in the tower, Aladar argued with the Tashikki ambassador until Navani began handing out duties, then offered Emul help against Tukar, which he followed through on.

When Dalinar withdrew from public life for a time, Aladar and three other highprinces brought Navani their worries about the tower's supplies and Dalinar's fitness to lead. She calmed their concerns, and Aladar's faith in Dalinar was restored.

Aladar led the meeting of monarchs while Dalinar recovered. They planned for battle in Jah Keved until Dalinar realised the enemy would strike Thaylen City instead. Aladar was at the next meeting in Thaylen City, where leaks such as the translation of the Eila Stele threatened the coalition.
During the battle at Thaylen City, Aladar stayed at Urithiru, where he helped Sebarial and Teft fight off invading singers. Afterwards he joined the conference on future plans.
Aladar continued to earn Dalinar's trust. During the campaign in Emul, he was put in charge of the withdrawal in Alethkar.

When Adolin asked for scribes during the fighting at Azimir, Aladar sent his best, including his daughter May, and briefly came himself. He told Adolin he was grateful for what the Kholins had built, admitting he had been nothing but selfish on the Shattered Plains.

appearance.text: A short, slender, dark-skinned man with a long neck and a bald head, wearing a thin moustache and a tuft of hair below his lip. As a highprince, his unconventional style often sets trends.

personality.text: A skilled duellist who owns full Shards but usually lends them to Highlord Mintez, Aladar prefers to lead his army tactically from a command tent. He likes games of chance, is a good politician, and is honest at heart.
He once found his daughter May's archery unladylike, but has come to accept it, though he still worries about her training with the house Plate and Blade.
